Reputation grows only through diverse, time-spaced endorsements, so a new identity starts with near-zero weight like a walnut that must be cracked open by real tasks. Cheap fakes sit as thin shale layers with no depth; to fake standing an attacker must run many agents for weeks, buy real work, and sustain varied partners, making the kernel of trust expensive to counterfeit.
